from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional, Literal

class FeeRecord(BaseModel):
    """Record of a court fee found in the document."""
    amount: Optional[float] = Field(description="The numeric amount of the fee")
    currency: str = Field(default="CNY", description="Currency of the fee")
    instance: str | None = Field(description="Which instance fee: '一审', '二审', or other")
    payer: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the fee")
    quote: str = Field(description="Original text segment mentioning the fee")

class JudgmentOutcome(BaseModel):
    """The main conclusion of the judgment."""
    conclusion: str = Field(description="The primary ruling text")
    is_final: bool = Field(description="Whether it is a final judgment")
    type: str = Field(description="Type of ruling: '驳回上诉', '驳回申请', '维持原判', etc.")

class DocumentInfo(BaseModel):
    """Extracted info for a single judgment document."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="Document title or identifier")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of case (Civil, Administrative, etc.)")
    procedure: str | None = Field(description="Procedure type (Second Instance, Retrial, etc.)")
    appellant_names: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Names of appellants/petitioners")
    appellee_names: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Names of appellees/respondents")
    judgment_outcome: JudgmentOutcome | None = Field(description="The main conclusion")
    second_instance_fee: Optional[float] = Field(description="Second instance fee amount if present")
    first_instance_fee: Optional[float] = Field(description="First instance fee amount if present")
    fee_payer_second: str | None = Field(description="Who pays the second instance fee")
    key_identifiers: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list, description="Other unique facts (names, amounts, terms) to match with results")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: List[DocumentInfo]
